description: This file defines an interface for time-related functions, including obtaining current time, calculating elapsed time, comparing times, and converting times to string or timespec format. It declares functions such as rtTime_Now, rtTime_Later, rtTime_Elapsed, rtTime_Compare, rtTime_ToString, and rtTime_ToTimespec, as well as associated types rtTime_t and rtTimespec_t.

methods.name: rtTime_Now
methods.description: Gets the current system time and stores it in the provided rtTime_t pointer.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a future time by adding a specified number of milliseconds to a given rtTime_t.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Computes the elapsed milliseconds between two times, defaulting to now if 'end' is NULL.

methods.name: rtTime_Compare
methods.description: Compares two times, returning -1 if left is earlier, 1 if later, or 0 if equal.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts a rtTime_t into a human-readable string in HH:MM:SS.mmm format.

methods.name: rtTime_ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts a rtTime_t into a timespec structure suitable for certain system calls.
